public_body: Old Colony Regional Technical High School District Committee
overall: The AG found the regional school committee violated the Open Meeting Law by omitting the reconvene statement and by preparing interview questions in executive session, declined the untimely July/August complaints, and found minutes were approved timely.

allegations.summary: Committee entered executive session on Aug. 31, 2016 without the chair stating whether it would reconvene in open session.
allegations.key_passage: This omission violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Committee discussed and prepared interview questions for superintendent finalists in executive session on Aug. 31, 2016, which allegedly lacked a proper statutory purpose.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore conclude that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.

allegations.summary: Search Committee allegedly convened in executive session on July 13 and 27, 2016 to prepare interview questions, improperly.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint was filed on September 20, 2016, we find that these allegations are untimely and we decline to review them.

allegations.summary: Committee allegedly failed to create and approve Search Committee meeting minutes in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee met only periodically during the time period at issue, we find that the Committee approved the Search Committee minutes within a reasonable period of time, and we therefore find no violation with respect to this allegation.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law ordered.
Committee may not redact or withhold the August 31, 2016 executive session minutes, or any portion, based on privilege or a Public Records Law exemption.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. Furthermore, because the August 31, 2016 executive session was not held for a proper purpose, the Committee may not redact or withhold these minutes or any portion thereof based on privilege or any exemption under the Public Records Law.
